mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_reads(conversation_id, user_id, last_read_message_id, last_read_time) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{lastReadMessageId}, #{lastReadTime}) ON CONFLICT (conversation_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET last_read_message_id = GREATEST( conversation_reads.last_read_message_id, EXCLUDED.last_read_message_id ), last_read_time = EXCLUDED.last_read_time
